title: Kuragehime: Eiyuu Retsuden
justification: AniList 9754 (SPECIAL, 4 episode(s) from 2011-01-28) is AniDB 7531's special(s) S7-S10, aired 2011-01-28 to 2011-04-22. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 7531. The parent node has no mapping rows, so S7-S10 default to TVDB 0x7-0x10.
